caption: The drawing depicts a carved, oval-shaped wooden container or box with an elaborate three-dimensional scene atop its lid. The primary colors used are various shades of muted brown, accented by darker and lighter earth tones, giving the object a wood-like appearance. On one end of the box, a sculpted male human figure with dark skin, sitting cross-legged, extends an arm forward as if reaching or pointing. In front of the figure is a carved animal resembling an alligator or crocodile, positioned so that the human figure appears to be interacting with it. Behind the human figure, a tall, triangular structure rises from the box's surface, textured and adorned as if it represents a tent or shelter. The sides of the box are decorated with geometric patterns and what appear to be floral or star motifs, rendered in subdued yellow, red, and green hues. Near the bottom left corner, there is the inscribed phrase "RICE & THE MOON". The drawing is centered on a cream-colored background with the artist's signature, "Geo. J. File", in the bottom right corner.
title: Toy Bank: Chief Big Moon
